model_note: Industry-wide ORF model change effective 2026-07-01: ORF is assessed only on customer-range transactions EXECUTED on the assessing exchange (previously on cleared customer volume regardless of venue). Rates before and after 2026-07-01 are not comparable; no pre-change history is encoded, so earlier dates raise.
